=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text tb " bytes "
text tc " characters\n"
text s1 "møøse"
text s2 "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢"
text s3 "J̲o̲s̲é̲"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note a UTF-8 code point starts at every byte that is not a continuation byte 10xxxxxx
fn show a view uchar * to void
n = ulong 0
for i ulong len a
if ne and get a i 192 128
n = add n 1
end
end
emit a
emit nl
emitu len a
emit tb
emitu n
emit tc
end
fn main to int
show s1
show s2
show s3
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
møøse
7 bytes 5 characters
𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢
28 bytes 7 characters
J̲o̲s̲é̲
13 bytes 8 characters
</pre>
